# 佛說慧印三昧經

**ID:** T0632
**Volume:** T15
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 吳 支謙譯
**Dynasty:** 吳
**Date:** 223–253
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0632

## Contributors
- 支謙 (A000164)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T632 (one fascicle, alt. title 慧印經; provisional Sanskrit *Tathāgatajñānamudrāsamādhi-sūtra*) is a short Mahāyāna *samādhi*-sūtra translated by [支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) (Zhī Qiān, fl. 222–253) at Jiànyè under the Wu. The text expounds the *huìyìn sānmèi* — a samādhi in which the meditator becomes "sealed" by the wisdom of the Tathāgatas, such that all *dharma*s are perceived as already containing the buddha-mark. It is the first of three Chinese versions: [T633](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0270) is an anonymous later rendering, and [T634](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0271) is a much-expanded Northern Song retranslation by [智吉祥](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%90%89%E7%A5%A5) and his colleagues.

**Abstract**

T632 is unanimously ascribed in the canonical bibliographies to [支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) (Zhī Qiān); the *[Chū sānzàng jì jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0084)* (T2145, juan 2) lists it among his works. Date bracket follows his productive period in Wu (222–253). As with [T631](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0268), the CANWWW database erroneously assigns T632 to [支曜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E6%9B%9C) (a data error in the AUT00021 key); the source colophon and all Chinese catalogs agree on Zhī Qiān. The text is an important early statement of the *jñāna-mudrā* (wisdom-seal) theme that was later expanded in tantric Buddhism. The "wisdom-seal" doctrine here developed influenced later Chinese exegesis on the relation between *prajñā* and *upāya*.
